annotations.title: Morse code translator: text to Morse and back

description: Translate text to international Morse code (letters separated by spaces, words by /) or Morse code back to text; the direction is detected automatically or set with mode. Letters, digits and common punctuation are supported; anything else is reported, not guessed. Use for puzzles, radio practice and fun messages. Example: text=SOS help. Price $0.002/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
